story.title: Application startup and retained analyzers
story.user_story: Verify the testing deployment after an update. Use an existing testing account with analyzer administration access. These checks only inspect existing data; do not create, activate, or delete an analyzer.

steps.do: Open testing.openelis-global.org and sign in with your existing testing account.
steps.expect: The application opens after sign-in without a System Error or a permanently pending request.

steps.do: Open the Analyzers page using this step's link. Inspect the existing analyzer list without changing any records.
steps.expect: The list loads. Any retained incomplete analyzer appears as Setup; it does not prevent other analyzers from loading.
